question: What is the meaning of recycled content in relation to products and materials?
description:
Recycled content refers to the proportion, by mass, of recycled material in a product. This indicates the amount of recycled material used in the manufacturing process of the product. <|ENDINPUT>

ium parts). Combined with low availability, external environment is
